headline: Keep an eye on airOS links
intro: Ubiquiti airOS brings device status and network metrics into Home Assistant for wireless links between buildings, remote sites, and other locations.
highlights: Connects to devices running airOS 6 or 8 that have already been configured in a browser or the UISP app
Provides binary sensors, buttons, sensors, and update entities, including link capacity, throughput, wireless frequency, and SSID
Device data is polled every 60 seconds; firmware availability is checked daily, and updates are supported on firmware v8

flow.title: From device to link metrics
stages: Configure an airOS 6 or 8 device in a browser or the UISP app
Add Ubiquiti airOS in Home Assistant
Review device status and wireless metrics
